proposals.analysis: mixed model: neighbour response ~ spot-neighbour distance + target response amplitude, random effects animal/pair; preregister contrast of the two slopes
proposals.decision_criterion: spot-distance slope CI excludes 0 at fixed target response -> direct photostimulation component; target-amplitude slope only -> mediated/contamination
proposals.manipulation: Stimulate a fixed target with the spot displaced laterally (0, 2, 4, 6 um) and axially (0, 3, 6 um) toward a matched neighbour; record target and neighbour at each displacement.
proposals.measurement: neighbour response probability vs spot-neighbour distance, holding target activation measured
proposals.name: spot_displacement_series

proposals.resolution: displacement step <= footprint FWHM/2 (~1.5 um lateral)
proposals.sample_structure: >= 8 animals x >= 10 target/neighbour pairs x 5 displacements x 5 repeats

proposals.decision_criterion: delay interval lower bound > 20 ms in most pairs -> propagation; within +/-20 ms -> simultaneous
proposals.manipulation: Image only the target plane and one neighbour plane at >= 50 Hz during stimulation.
proposals.measurement: receiver-minus-target onset delay at ~20 ms resolution
